name: cove-tarot-companion
title_zh: 把塔罗牌阵变成一场本地私密对话仪式
tagline_zh: 不联网、不云端，牌阵在本地浏览器里展开。当对话出现合适契机，它轻声邀你抽一张，聊回最初的解读。
tagline_en: No cloud, no accounts—your spread unfolds in a local browser. When the chat hits the right beat, it gently.
desc_en: Use when a user wants a local Tarot Ritual, returns from one to discuss its original reading, or a companion conversation offers a suitable moment to invite them. Requires an existing local shell and browser; not for independently drawing or reinterpreting cards.
why_zh: 它不替你解牌，而是把牌阵当作对话的锚点。每次返回都重新连接你与那张牌的原始语境，让仪式感长在本地而非服。
why_en: It doesn't read for you—it anchors the conversation to the spread. Every return reconnects you to the card's original context.
limit_zh: 需要你已有一个本地 shell 和浏览器环境，且只能用于讨论既有牌阵，不能独立抽牌或重新解读。若对话里没有合适契机。
limit_en: Requires an existing local shell and browser; only discusses existing spreads—no independent draws or reinterpretations. It stays silent unless the.
